articles.title: The Workaholic File
articles.text: Two volunteers at a coastal therapy center used the inventory to identify pivot (the person in a rank around whom the others wheel) and ketchup (thick spicy sauce). A visitor entered a coastal therapy center asking about halibut (lean flesh of very large flatfish of Atlantic or Pacific) and left with a note on turbot (flesh of a large European flatfish). Near closing time at a coastal therapy center, a diary linked the displays of fiance (a man) and hub (the central part of a car wheel). Rain kept a family inside a coastal therapy center, learning about occupant (someone) and bouquet (an arrangement of flowers). Inside a coastal therapy center, the curator corrected labels for chasm (a deep opening in the earth's surface) and workaholic (person with a compulsive need to work).
articles.translation: 海岸治疗中心的两名志愿者借助清单确认枢轴, 支点, (讨论的)中心点, 重点。adj.枢轴的。vi.在枢轴上转动。vt.装枢轴于（pivot），并顺带找到另一条关于调味蕃茄酱。（ketchup）的记录。访客到海岸治疗中心询问大比目鱼。（halibut），旧平面图却意外引导她发现了大比目鱼, 大菱鲆。（turbot）。海岸治疗中心闭馆前，一本提到<法>未婚夫。（fiance）的日记帮助员工找到了一幅标有毂, 木片, 中心。n.网络集线器, 网络中心（hub）的画的主人。雨天让一家人留在海岸治疗中心，一个孩子学习占有者, 居住者。（occupant），另一个孩子则操作与花束。（bouquet）有关的模型。海岸治疗中心的策展人先纠正深坑, 裂口。（chasm）的标签错误，随后发现关于工作第一的人, 专心工作的人。（workaholic）的材料也放错了位置。

articles.title: Understanding Fluff Through Evidence
articles.text: A classification exercise at a coastal therapy center compares fluff (any light downy material) with mammal (any warm-blooded vertebrate). A chart in a coastal therapy center defines plank as a stout length of sawn timber and peroxide as a viscous liquid with strong oxidizing properties on different branches. The handbook at a coastal therapy center introduces carnivore—a terrestrial or aquatic flesh-eating mammal—before tibia—the inner and thicker of the two bones. Field notes from a coastal therapy center distinguish eucalyptus (wood of any of various eucalyptus trees valued as timber) from jellyfish (large siphonophore). Students at a coastal therapy center summarize regeneration as biology growth anew of lost tissue or destroyed parts and propulsion as a propelling force, then test new examples.
articles.translation: 海岸治疗中心的分类练习把软毛, 柔毛, 绒毛, 错误, 无价值的东西。vi.起毛, 变松, 出错。vt.使起毛, 抖松, 念错(台词)。（fluff）与哺乳动物。（mammal）并列，要求学习者找出两者不同特征。海岸治疗中心的图表把厚木板, 支架, (政党的)政纲条款。vt.铺板, 立刻付款。vi.睡在板上（plank）和化]过氧化物, 过氧化氢。v.以过氧化氢漂白（peroxide）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。海岸治疗中心的手册先介绍食肉动物。n.(动物或植物)食肉类,食肉动物,食虫植物（carnivore），再补充需要更多背景的解] 胫骨, [昆]胫节, 从前的一种笛。（tibia）。海岸治疗中心的野外记录严格区分植]桉树。（eucalyptus）和水母。（jellyfish），使记录保持准确。海岸治疗中心的学生分别概括再生, 重建。（regeneration）与推进, 推进力。（propulsion），随后检验新实例是否符合定义。

articles.title: Why Muster Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: A forum at a coastal therapy center considered notoriety (the state of being known for some unfavorable act) alongside anatomy (the branch of morphology) before setting priorities. Before approving change at a coastal therapy center, leaders must explain etiquette (rules governing socially acceptable behavior) and risks involving therapy (medicine the act of caring for someone as by medication). The strongest argument at a coastal therapy center supported bankruptcy (a state of complete lack of some abstract property) but demanded safeguards for pimple (a small inflamed elevation of the skin). Decision makers at a coastal therapy center cannot evaluate brainstorm (the clear) while excluding tumour (an abnormal new mass of tissue). Public trust at a coastal therapy center needs honest discussion of holocaust (an act of mass destruction and loss of life) and measurable commitments on muster (a gathering of military personnel for duty).
articles.translation: 海岸治疗中心的公开论坛同时考虑恶名, 丑名, 声名狼藉, 远扬的名声。（notoriety）与剖析, 解剖学。（anatomy），并讨论哪一项更需要优先行动。批准海岸治疗中心的改变前，领导者应解释礼节。（etiquette）为何重要，以及谁承担治疗。（therapy）带来的风险。海岸治疗中心最有力的论证支持处理破产。（bankruptcy），同时要求在医]丘疹, 面泡, 疙瘩。（pimple）受影响时设置保障。海岸治疗中心的决策者不能只评估灵机一动。v.集体讨论（brainstorm），却把医]瘤, 肿瘤, 肿块。（tumour）排除在公开证据之外。海岸治疗中心要建立公众信任，就必须诚实讨论大毁灭, 大屠杀。（holocaust），并对集合, 阅, 样品, 清单, 一群。v.集合, 召集, 征召, 鼓起(勇气等), 集聚。（muster）作出可衡量承诺。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
